Number of days between booking entry and scheduled arrival.
Scheduled arrival year.

Day of month of the scheduled arrival.

Number of weekday nights included in the booking.

definition: Number of changes made to the booking.
model_usage: Excluded because changes can occur after booking creation.

model_usage: Excluded because it may not be known at initial booking time.

definition: Customer classification such as Transient, Contract, or Group.
Average daily room rate associated with the booking.

Number of special requests made by the guest.

model_usage: Excluded because it is recorded after the booking outcome.

definition: Audit flag indicating that the row belongs to an identical-value group.
transformation_or_cleaning_rule: 1 when the original row belongs to an identical-value group; otherwise 0.
model_usage: Audit-only field; not used as a predictive feature.

definition: Indicator that an agent identifier was present in the source data.
transformation_or_cleaning_rule: 1 when source agent is not missing; otherwise 0.

definition: Indicator that a company identifier was present in the source data.
transformation_or_cleaning_rule: 1 when source company is not missing; otherwise 0.

definition: Complete scheduled arrival date created from the source date fields.
Total guests calculated as adults plus children plus babies.
